Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following foundational works on digital edition architecture, transformation pipelines, and long-term preservation:

  • Sahle, Patrick. "What is a Digital Scholarly Edition?" In Digital Scholarly Editing: Theories and Practices, ed. M. J. Driscoll and E. Pierazzo, Open Book Publishers, 2016, pp. 19–39.
  • Pierazzo, Elena. Digital Textual Scholarship: Theories, Methods and Common Practices. Ashgate/Routledge, 2015. Focus on Chapter 4 (Modelling) and Chapter 5 (Publishing).
  • Turska, Magdalena, James Cummings, and Sebastian Rahtz. "Challenging the Myth of Presentation in 'Pure' TEI: The TEI Processing Model." Journal of the Text Encoding Initiative, Issue 10, 2016.
